# Concrete Verification Fixture

Use this skill when the user asks you to review or fix code.

## Instructions

Inspect the target and make the change if needed. Check that everything works.

## Verification

Make sure the implementation is high quality and say whether it looks good.

## Output

Say what you did and whether you are done.
